verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state that Copilot's agent capabilities (cloud agent, agent apps, automations) are accessed through the existing Copilot subscription rather than a separate sign-in or purchase ('Agent apps let you use partner-built agents directly in your workflows on GitHub, powered by your Copilot subscription'; 'Access to Cloud agent and code review'), confirming a single subscription unlocks agent mode across editor and cloud. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the sign-in/subscription-gating flow and clarity on which specific paid tiers unlock agent access.
